notes: Measured pixel-exact on AE 2026 8 bpc (Minimum r 4, Maximum r 4, Maximum r 6 Alpha and Color): the window is a SQUARE (2r+1)^2, i.e. separable (disk / diamond / premultiplied models are clearly wrong, 0.2-1.6 % mean); it works on STRAIGHT 8-bit colour channel by channel and the result is premultiplied by the new alpha. Channel 1 = Color (RGB, alpha untouched), 2 = Alpha and Color (measured); 3 = Alpha, 4/5/6 = Red/Green/Blue are AE's menu order, unmeasured. Operation 1 Minimum, 2 Maximum (measured), 3 Minimum then Maximum, 4 Maximum then Minimum (second stage on the first stage's output with the same radius; checked against a numpy model only). Direction 1 = Horizontal and Vertical (measured), 2 = Just Horizontal, 3 = Just Vertical (numpy model only). Outside the layer = transparent black; Don't Shrink Edges = 1 ignores the outside instead (unmeasured: the refs' content is inset). Radius rounded to an integer (fractional radii unmeasured), capped at 1024 px (larger = clamped). 4 passes (stage 1 H, stage 1 V, stage 2 H, stage 2 V; unused passes copy through), intermediates hold straight colour + alpha in RGBA8 (exact, AE is 8-bit straight), the last pass premultiplies. Cost 2r+1 taps per pass. Not reproduced: Compositing Options (AE 6). Maximum with Alpha and Color can grow content past the layer edge: AE's behaviour there is unmeasured (pad 0 recommended).
